Recreation Commission with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Monday of every month at 6:00 p.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the Community Services Department via email at
kshigenaga@cityofsanmarino.org or by phone at (626) 300­0791 at least 48 hours prior to
the meeting.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Recreation
Commission on any item of interest that is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the
Recreation Commission. Pursuant to state law, the Recreation Commission may not discuss or
take action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The
Chair reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to
follow up on such items.

MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO RECREATION COMMISSION
  MONDAY, MARCH 13, 2023 AT 6:00 P.M.
  BARTH ROOM, CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY

CALL TO ORDER: Vice Chairperson Solan called the regular meeting to order at 6:10 p.m. in the
Barth Room, located at 1890 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Vice Chairperson Solan led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL:  PRESENT: Commissioner Tam, Commissioner Wu, Vice Chairperson Solan,
  and Chairperson Yen (arrived at 6:13 p.m.)

  ABSENT: Commissioner Tsai

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

COMMISSIONER REPORTS

No reports were given at this time.

NEW BUSINESS

1. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

Commissioner Wu moved, seconded by Vice Chairperson Solan, to approve the minutes from
February 13, 2023.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Commissioner Tam, Commissioner Wu, Vice Chairperson Solan, and Chairperson
  Yen
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Commissioner Tsai

2. DIRECTOR AND RECREATION MANAGER REPORT

Director Johnson and Recreation Manager Covarrubias presented the staff report.
 RECREATION COMMISSION MINUTES  REGULAR MEETING
MARCH 13, 2023  PAGE 2 OF 3

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

3. STATUS UPDATE ON RECREATION DIVISION’S FY 2022-23 GOALS AND
  OBJECTIVES (WORK PLANS)

Director Johnson presented the staff report. Chairperson Yen asked what website platform the City
uses, who manages the content, and if analytics are looked at. Recreation Manager Covarrubias
responded that the City uses Revize. Director Johnson responded that static information is managed
by Community Engagement Manager Cuadras and dynamic information is managed by the Division.
She added that webpage analytics will be utilized throughout the website revamp project.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

4. REVIEW AND DISCUSS DRAFT FACILITY USE AND RENTAL GUIDELINES
  DOCUMENT

Director Johnson presented the staff report. Commissioner Tam inquired if facility rentals can be
booked online. Recreation Manager Covarrubias responded that Lacy Park rentals can be made
online, but staff are careful with weekend rentals as those tend to be larger events, like weddings,
that may need to evaluated on a case by case basis. Chairperson Yen recommended that it be made
clear on the online reservation system that the kitchen is a catering kitchen only. He also requested
that the Commission test the reservation website before it goes live. Commissioner Tam inquired
about the timeline of the San Marino Center project and if a tour is possible. Director Johnson
shared that the general timeline for the re-grand opening is end of August or beginning of September,
and that she will look into a tour for the Commission.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

Commissioner Wu moved, seconded by Commissioner Tam, to execute Step 2 and advise staff to
bring the item back for further discussion at the April 10 Commission meeting.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Commissioner Tam, Commissioner Wu, Vice Chairperson Solan, and Chairperson
  Yen
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Commissioner Tsai
